invariants.winding: Consistently outward triangle winding for tube sides and caps
invariants.coincidence: UV seam duplicate vertices coincide with j=0; base and tip cap perimeters copy rough tube rim positions
invariants.finiteValidation: All morphology, dimensions, and fork parameters checked for finite bounds before list/mesh allocation
invariants.scalePolicy: Fail closed before generation/mutation for unsupported non-unit, non-uniform, mirrored, or sheared hierarchy
invariants.meshOwnership: Track owned procedural mesh only, atomic replacement on successful generation, safe destruction on cleanup, external meshes preserved
invariants.determinism: Algorithmic explicit seed-driven 32-bit XorShift PRNG stream on same runtime; zero UnityEngine.Random, clock time, or frame rate dependence; no cross-platform bit-for-bit guarantee
invariants.colorVariation: Authored bark and end-grain vertex colors and procedural textures generated via existing Unity APIs with guarded dimensions
invariants.physicsIntegration: Explicitly NONE; stated dimensions, volume, and dry mass are authored estimates for staging, not measured species data
invariants.siblingBoundaries: Independent asset generator; explicit conversion bridge depending on CityLife.Items.PhysicalDimensions; no inventory, save, or fuel adapters
